issue: The payment sheet listed six rows, Apple Pay and Google Pay both, though a phone can only ever offer one of them; the frequent sheet carried a choice that can only fail.
fix: R.payList draws only the platform wallet (Apple Pay on the iPhone mock, Google Pay with os:'android'); five rows, every method the owner set kept. Also in airport-pay, ride pay-change and done card-declined, which share it.

issue: The search cancel sheet put «Չեղարկել պատվերը» at the bottom, where the ride CancelSheet, sign-out and delete sheets put the way back, so a learned thumb cancels the order.
fix: Swapped: red action above, «Շարունակել որոնումը» at the bottom, matching every other confirm sheet in the app.

issue: The end of every cash ride opened on a five-line breakdown ending in «Կլորացում +41 ֏» on a price agreed up front, pushing the stars down and leaving a surcharge as the last money note, while the rated state already had it collapsed.
fix: Rate (and company) open the breakdown on «Գնի մանրամասները» like rated/low; promo and card keep it open because there it explains why the number differs.

issue: A house number 2GIS does not know («Մաշտոցի 999») dead-ended in «Ոչինչ չի գտնվել» although the street matched.
fix: Offer the street as the nearest result («… չգտնվեց · ամենամոտը», then the building on the map) with «Նշել քարտեզին» under it; the bare blank is kept only for a query with no match at all (note updated).

issue: The note says the plate grows on arrival, but it was the same size as on assigned, so the moment the rider must match a plate to a car had no visible change in the one thing being read.
fix: On arrived the plate steps up (48 px, 29 px numerals) and the car art shrinks to make room.

issue: «Պրոմոկոդ» was a filled full-width field directly above Order, the second-largest shape on a sheet where most rides carry no code.
fix: The not-yet-entered row is a quiet 44 pt text row (icon + word, no fill); the applied-code row keeps its fill.

issue: The highlights of the promo state were unreadable at night: «−165 ֏» and the discounted tier price used --brand (a fill) as text at 3.2:1, and the struck price in Order was dimmed to 3.1:1.
fix: Brand as text uses --brand-ink; the strike alone says 'was' in the button, no dimming.

issue: The same step is drawn two ways: rider-tiers has a payment row plus a note icon, rider-book details has when · note · payment chips plus promo; an implementer cannot tell which is canonical.
fix: Owner to confirm rider-book details as the sheet and mark rider-tiers as the tier-row reference only (left: rider-tiers is the owner-approved base).
note: rider-tiers now carries a visible side annotation naming it the tier-row reference only; rider-book's details sheet is canonical (also in RIDER-NOTES.md). rider-tiers' base was not redrawn.

issue: Only Armenian-script input is shown resolving; tourists and Russian speakers will type «mashtots» or «Маштоц», and nothing shows the list accepting that.
fix: Add a suggest state with a Latin or Cyrillic query returning the same Armenian rows (2GIS suggest is hy/ru/en).
note: Added states suggest-latin («mashtots», English keyboard) and suggest-ru («Маштоц», Russian keyboard), both returning the same Armenian rows with the matched name bold; R.keyboard() takes 'en' | 'ru'.

issue: The When sheet shows a flat grid of quarter-hour slots (up to 96 for tomorrow) under seven day chips, with no grouping to scan.
fix: Chunk the slots under hour or part-of-day headers (morning / afternoon / evening) and keep the no-wheel decision.
note: Slots chunked under part-of-day headers (Գիշեր / Առավոտ / Ցերեկ / Երեկո), no wheel, fixed 300 px window. The audit overlap with «Հաստատել» was real (a clipped sixth row still in the DOM over the button); only whole rows that fit are drawn now.

issue: Prices are pending but Order shows no sign that it will carry a price; a rider who taps fast does not know the fixed price will still be confirmed.
fix: Keep the price slot skeleton in the button too («Պատվիրել · Eco City · ▭») so the label does not jump when the quote lands.
note: quote-loading: the Order button now ends in a skeleton chip for the price («Պատվիրել · Eco City · ▭»), with an aria-label saying the price is being calculated.

issue: Cancel is one of four equal circles, next to Share, told apart only by a pink tint; a mis-tap opens the reasons sheet rather than cancelling, so the cost is a detour.
fix: Move Cancel to the far end with a gap, or to a text button under the row, as Uber and Yandex Go do.
note: Cancel moved out of the action row into a 44 px danger-toned text button under call / write / share (assigned, arriving, arrived).

issue: The selected tier's mark is a leaf in a green disc, which reads as an 'eco' badge on Eco City rather than 'selected'.
fix: Use a check on selection and keep the leaf as tier identity, or rely on the ink ring alone.
note: Selected tier shows a check, not a leaf, in rider-book (leaf stays in rider-tiers, which is the untouched reference).

issue: The partner ad carousel takes about a quarter of the sheet, more than the recent places that start a booking.
fix: Cap the ad at one card height below two recents, or move it below the fold of the sheet.
note: Ad cards 156 -> 120 px (house card too, its mark moved right); the two recents stay above. Scrim stops re-derived so contrast still passes.

issue: The payment row names «Apple Pay / Google Pay» together; on an iPhone the rider only has one.
fix: Name only the platform wallet, as the payment sheet now does.
note: Payment list names only the phone's own wallet (Apple Pay in the iPhone mock).

issue: The indeterminate bar never advances, so a long search reads as stalled.
fix: Pair it with what is happening («Առաջարկը ուղարկված է մոտակա վարորդին», as answering does) once the first offer is out.
note: New state next-offer: «Առաջարկը ուղարկված է հաջորդ վարորդին» under the title while the bar runs, so a long search shows what moved.

issue: Tapping a star still needs «Ուղարկել»; a 5-star rider who wants to leave takes two taps.
fix: Submit 5 ★ on tap after a short undo window; keep Send for 1–4 ★ where chips follow.
note: rated: 5 star goes on the tap, a 4 s undo bar («5 աստղը ուղարկվում է · Հետարկել») replaces Send; compliments stay optional above it. New state rated-4 keeps Send for 1-4 star.

issue: The fare sits inline after the destination on the same line, so a long Armenian street name meets the price with no gap.
fix: Right-align the fare in its own fixed column, like the distances in search.
note: Fare gets its own right-aligned flex-none column (min 56 px) and the title takes the rest, so a long street name cannot meet the price.

issue: Half the screen is empty above the check, so the close looks unfinished next to Bolt's card-led thanks.
fix: Lift the block to the optical centre and show the route trace and fare as a small card.
note: thanks: block lifted to the optical centre and a small card added (route trace, two addresses, method · driver, fare).

issue: The last thing on the share page is «Պատվիրել Eco Taxi», an outlined button at the same weight as the content, so the page ends on a sales ask rather than the ride status.
fix: Keep it, but as a smaller text link under the privacy line.
note: «Պատվիրել Eco Taxi» is now a small underlined text link under the privacy line, in both states.
